technique_name: Name and describe three tools used to measure the success of a website.
description: Three tools used to measure the success of a website are web analytics, A/B testing, and surveys. Web analytics is a tool that provides detailed insights into a website’s traffic, pageviews, bounce rate, and visitor engagement. This can help determine the effectiveness of branding and marketing activities.
